labels.title: The Value Proposition Canvas
labels.valueProposition: Smart Hisab – Canteen POS & Meal ERP Platform
labels.customerSegment: Commercial Canteens, University Dining Halls, Factory Cafeterias & Institutional Caterers

customerJobs.title: Core Workflow 1
customerJobs.note: Guarantee sub-second counter throughput during lunch rush without internet dependency

customerJobs.title: Core Workflow 2
customerJobs.note: Maintain financial double-entry integrity between customer payments, cashier cashbooks, and vendor food purchases

customerJobs.title: Core Workflow 3
customerJobs.note: Support multiple user clearance levels (Superadmin, Cashier, Kitchen Manager, Auditor)

pains.title: Peak-Hour Counter Congestion
pains.note: Web apps freeze or lag when 300+ students or workers queue for meals simultaneously on spotty cafeteria Wi-Fi.

pains.title: Cash Discrepancies & Drawer Leaks
pains.note: Multiple cashiers change shifts without structured drawer counts, leading to untracked register shortages.

pains.title: Uncollected Meal Credit
pains.note: Manual credit ledgers lead to disputes over diner meal tabs and unpaid month-end balances.

gains.title: Offline-First Instant Dispatch
gains.note: Flutter SQLite engine issues meal tokens in <1.2 seconds with instant Bluetooth thermal receipt printing.

gains.title: Atomic Shift Cashbook
gains.note: Enforces mandatory opening float declaration, mid-day cash drops, and closing drawer audit before handover.

gains.title: Real-Time Meal AR & Wallets
gains.note: Digital diner balances, monthly pre-paid credit limits, and automated payroll deduction exports.
